name: John Varnum
bio: a Representative from Massachusetts; born in Dracut, Middlesex County, Mass., June 25, 1778; graduated from Harvard University in 1798; studied law; admitted to the bar and commenced practice in Haverhill, Mass., in 1802; elected as a Federalist to the Massachusetts state senate in 1811; moved to Lowell, Mass.; elected as an Adams candidate to the Nineteenth and to the succeeding Congress; elected as an Anti-Jacksonian candidate to the Twenty-first Congress (March 4, 1825-March 3, 1831); returned to Lowell, Mass., and later moved to Niles, Berrien County, Mich., where he died July 23, 1836; interment in Silverbrook Cemetery.
